title: How India's GST Council Works

metadata.confidenceRationale: Based on official GST Council records

hero.caption: Central GST rate on most goods

summary: The GST Council decides indirect tax rates and rules for India's goods and services tax regime through a voting mechanism.

keyFacts.claim: GST Council is a constitutional body under Article 279A
Decisions require 3/4th majority of voting members

whyItMatters: GST rates affect every Indian consumer and business.
narrative: The GST Council comprises the Centre and states, with each state having one vote regardless of population. The voting formula gives the Centre less than 1/3rd weight, ensuring states have a decisive voice.

systemExplanation.headline: How the GST Council Works
systemExplanation.summary: A constitutional mechanism where Centre and states jointly decide GST rates and rules.

steps.label: Proposal
steps.description: A rate change or rule amendment is proposed by the Centre or any state.

steps.label: Deliberation
steps.description: Members discuss and negotiate the proposed change.

steps.label: Voting
steps.description: Decision requires 3/4th of weighted votes. Centre's vote weight is 1/3rd; states' collectively 2/3rd.

stakeholders.headline: Key Stakeholders
stakeholders.summary: Centres, states, and businesses interact through the Council.
